detail: Updates - We hereby inform that AU Small Finance Bank ( AU SFB ) has received RBI s letter dated September 8, 2026 according its approval to ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited ( I-Pru AMC ) (along with the schemes of ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund, funds under AIF managed by I-Pru AMC, clients of PMS of I-Pru AMC) to acquire  aggregate holding  of up to 9.95% of the paid-up share capital or voting rights in AU SFB. The aforesaid approval granted by RBI is subject to compliance with the relevant provisions of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 and applicable RBI s directions, provisions of the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999, regulations issued by Securities and Exchange…
